description: An Iceberg expose's maintenance block (0.7.7 preview): its closed member set, backend enum, schedule, timezone, build and roleArn, the Glue run interval's bounds, the compaction, rewriteManifests, expireSnapshots and removeOrphanFiles blocks with their bounds, enums and ISO-8601 durations, and the actions array; and, in place of a build, the runtime of a table no forge build writes (its runtime enum, the role and the application, cluster or virtual cluster each EMR runtime needs, and that a build and a runtime are never both).
